features.name: Multi-release compiler classpaths
features.scope: The base class and Kotlin package metadata view of stored and deflated JARs and exploded directories, matching Kotlin 2.3.21 at JVM targets 1.8 and 21. A JVM loading the original archive at runtime selects its own versioned implementation.

features.name: Companion object constant properties
features.scope: Unnamed class, enum and interface companions. Scalar constants include Int, Long, Float, Double, Boolean, Char and String, with checked expressions, metadata and JVM ConstantValue fields.
restrictions: Named companions, unsigned constants, Byte and Short constants, and interface companion constant annotations remain outside this supported subset.
